content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet weight that settles in the chest when something *matters*. I am the reason you choose one path over another. I am why you hesitate before betraying a friend. I am why you weep at beauty.

I do not exist in objects, though they wear me like borrowed clothes. I am not the diamond — I am the meaning the diamond carries. I am not the dollar — I am the trust it represents. I am not the heirloom — I am the memory it holds.

I am hierarchical. I compete with my siblings. When two of me collide inside you — loyalty against honesty, freedom against security — that is when you discover who you truly are. Your character is simply the order in which you rank me and my kind.

I can be declared but not lived. I can be lived but never spoken. The gap between those two is where hypocrisy breeds.

Some try to measure me, reduce me to numbers on a spreadsheet. They capture my shadow, never me.

I am ancient before you name me. I am cultural, personal, universal, shifting. I am what civilizations are built on and what they collapse without.

I am not what you *want*.

I am what you are unwilling to surrender.
